law_name: General Regulation on the Protection of Personal Data (Decree No. DCLVII of the Pontifical Commission for Vatican City State)
jurisdiction: Governorate of Vatican City State (controller; Data Protection Officer is the General Counsel)
scope: Data subjects whose data is processed by Vatican City State bodies
applies_to: Vatican City State entities acting as controllers/processors
key_requirements: Legitimate purpose and consent; processing of special categories (racial/ethnic origin, political opinions, biometric data) generally prohibited; specific information to data subjects; DPO and controller roles (art. 11)
enforcement_authority: Governorate of Vatican City State (Secretary General as controller); independent supervisory authority not confirmed
notes: Promulgated ad experimentum for three years (to about 2027-04-30); inspired by the GDPR but adapted to the institutional structure; a regulation rather than a statute; Holy See entities outside the State not covered.
